theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.channel_casoratian_const {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (σ : R →+* R) {c V0 V1 V2 : R} (hc : σ c = c) (h : V2 = c * V1 - V0) :
(V1 + σ V1) * (V2 - σ V2) - (V2 + σ V2) * (V1 - σ V1) = (V0 + σ V0) * (V1 - σ V1) - (V1 + σ V1) * (V0 - σ V0)

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.casoratian_step {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A B X0 X1 X2 Y0 Y1 Y2 : R} (hX : X2 = A * X1 + B * X0) (hY : Y2 = A * Y1 + B * Y0) :
X1 * Y2 - X2 * Y1 = -B * (X0 * Y1 - X1 * Y0)

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.chM_eigencolumn_iff {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q θ : R) (v : ℕ → R) :
(∀ (n : ℕ), chM q v n = θ * v n) ↔ (1 - q) * v 1 = θ * v 0 ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), (1 - q ^ (n + 2)) * v (n + 2) + v n = θ * v (n + 1)

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.chM_eq_L_add_R {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q : R) (v : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
chM q v n = chL q v n + chR v n

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.chLR_comm {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q : R) (v : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
chL q (chR v) n - chR (chL q v) n = (1 - q) * chQ q v n

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.chLQ_rel {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q : R) (v : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
chL q (chQ q v) n = q * chQ q (chL q v) n

theorem QOU.MassEndomorphism.chQR_rel {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (q : R) (v : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
chQ q (chR v) n = q * chR (chQ q v) n
